_README: Hand-picked person-track ids per video, for generate_lstm_training_data.py's
--target-tracks flag. A video listed here skips automatic target selection AND
fragment linking entirely and uses exactly the ids given. Videos NOT listed here
are unaffected and still use the automatic path, so this file only needs entries
for clips the heuristic gets wrong.
Track ids are NOT stable across runs: they come from the tracker and will change
if you change --tracker, --yolo-model, --yolo-imgsz or the YOLO weights. If you
change any of those, re-run review_tracks.py and rebuild these lists.
To add a video:  uv run python review_tracks.py --video <path> --out-dir <dir> --device cuda:0
then read its contact sheet (each tile shows its own track green, everyone else
red) and keep only the ids that are your subject.

note: 22.3 min. A second person (black t-shirt, light grey 'CZBA' tracksuit trousers)
enters at ~758s, takes over the task while the subject watches, and works until
~847s; the subject is off-frame ~816-828s. Verified visually from cropped
id=462 was in the AUTOMATIC selection, so the automatic result for this video
was contaminated with the second person -- that is why it is overridden here.
The subject wears a black top with dark wide-leg jeans throughout; ids 483-754
were each confirmed as her working with the drill.
